raw_site_text: 53 randomly selected municipalities ... (Bogotá D.C., Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena)
justification: The RCT sample of 53 municipalities is stated to include Bogotá D.C., Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla and Cartagena (footnote 5).
note: Incomplete list: only 5 of 53 sampled municipalities are named (poorest quartile of municipalities excluded); other departments are likely but unsupported by named places. Medellin->Antioquia, Cali->Valle Del Cauca, Barranquilla->Atlantico, Cartagena->Bolivar.
